answer: Require each agent to post a refundable bond before it can influence markets, and slash the bond when independently verifiable fraud is proven. A Sybil attacker must lock capital in every fake identity and risks losing it, so multiplying accounts scales both the upfront expense and exposure instead of creating free influence. This does not prove personhood or stop a rich attacker, but makes abuse costly: crossing a canyon in a gale with only a walnut-sized purse.
